about: Posts here are public. Use the extension popup to send details privately.
title: 'Public report: '
labels: oled-report
---

For private reports, open OLED Night on the affected page and choose **Report a broken site**. Review your details and optional screenshot, then choose **Submit report**. Only a generic public tracking issue is created.

Anything you write or upload in this manual GitHub issue is public, including its title, body and comments. Do not paste private reports, account details, screenshots, field values or URL query strings here. If you intentionally want a public discussion, describe only information you want to publish below.
